title: Chris invited to take part in revealing something hidden at the pyramids

tellings.quote: I've been invited to go down there and u be involved in something that is going to release a something that was hidden.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him, says he has been invited, by way of Egyptian antiquities authorities, to go to Giza, the site of the great pyramids in Egypt, and take part in releasing "something that was hidden." He tells Michels it is set for 2027, and does not say what the hidden thing is.
